question: Imaging in surgery, EXCEPT
question_ar: التصوير في الجراحة، كلها صحيحة باستثناء؟ (سؤال مكرر، راجع السؤال رقم 549)

options.text: In abdominal X-Ray, the transverse colon can be seen in various locations in the centre of the abdomen because it is a totally intraperitoneal organ
Gallstones are usually seen on X-Ray
The presence of gas in the small bowel raise the suspicion of bowel obstruction
Ultrasound is better than CT scan for gallstones detected
Ultrasound can assess solid organs better than gas-filled organs

correct_text: Gallstones are usually seen on X-Ray
